eidolons.name: That Which We Stride Is the Trailblaze
eidolons.desc: The number of extra Assist Skill uses from Talent additionally increases by 1. While in the "Companion Protocol: Verdict" state, reduces the number of Ultimate uses required to launch Assist Skill by 1. While in the "Companion Protocol: Decimation" state, reduces the Charge required to launch Assist Skill by 3. When Himeko • Nova launches Assist Skill, the number of extra DMG instances increases by 1.

eidolons.name: The Colors We Never Strike
eidolons.desc: The cap of Himeko • Nova's Assist Skill uses increases to 2, and the DMG dealt by Ultimate and Assist Skill becomes 130% of their original DMG. During the "Navigator's Semaphore" state, at the start of each turn, additionally recovers 1 use of Assist Skill immediately. When a non-Trailblaze Companions character uses Assist Skill, the Trace "Hark! The Express's Pulse Roars" now also grants them 1 extra turn.

eidolons.name: We Who Are Starborn Muse Starward
eidolons.desc:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

eidolons.name: Let No Skyward Hand Stay Unheld
eidolons.desc: When using Assist Skill via the Talent "Of Fire and Far Faring," the All-Type RES PEN boost now applies to all allies. And when Himeko • Nova gains this effect, her All-Type RES PEN additionally increases by 10%.

eidolons.name: To Cross the Cosmos and Beyond
eidolons.desc:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

eidolons.name: Ours Is the Oath to Sail Starward
eidolons.desc: Himeko • Nova's Fire RES PEN increases by 20%. The cap of "Source Energy" increases to 6. When an ally uses or launches Assist Skill, DMG dealt by Assist Skill increases by 75%, and Himeko • Nova gains 1 "Source Energy." When launching "Hyperluminal Particle Beam" during Ultimate, additionally gains 1 "Source Energy". When launching "Orbital Annihilation Pulse," if the current "Source Energy" is 6 or more, additionally deals 1 instance of Fire DMG to all enemies, equal to 160% of Himeko • Nova's ATK.

basic.name: Enkindle the First Lodestar
basic.desc: Deals Fire DMG equal to {0}% of Himeko • Nova's ATK to one enemy.

skill.name: Upraise the Vanward Cresset
skill.desc: After using Skill, immediately recovers all Assist Skill uses. Himeko • Nova gains "Navigator's Semaphore," lasting for 3 turn(s). This duration decreases by 1 at the start of Himeko • Nova's every turn. When Himeko • Nova has "Navigator's Semaphore," DMG dealt by all allies increases by {0}%. At the start of every turn, immediately recovers 1 Assist Skill use.

ult.name: We, Too, Stride the Stars
ult.desc:
Immediately takes control of "Starblazer." "Starblazer" can launch "Hyperluminal Particle Beam" against enemies 6 times, or consume "Source Energy" to launch "Orbital Annihilation Pulse," dealing Fire DMG up to {1}% of Himeko • Nova's ATK to one designated enemy, and Fire DMG up to {2}% of Himeko • Nova's ATK to other targets.
When the uses of "Hyperluminal Particle Beam" are depleted, automatically launches "Orbital Annihilation Pulse," followed by Final Hit, dealing 3 instance(s) of DMG, with each instance dealing Fire DMG equal to {0}% of Himeko • Nova's ATK to one random enemy.
When "Hyperluminal Particle Beam" or "Orbital Annihilation Pulse" deals fatal damage to all enemies on the field, or when enemy HP can no longer be reduced, immediately launches Final Hit.

talent.name: Of Fire and Far Faring
talent.desc:
While Himeko • Nova is on the field, immediately deploys the Territory "Starblazer Visioscape," summoning "Starblazer" to the field and granting all ally characters 1 Assist Skill use. Ally characters can use Assist Skill to call upon "Starblazer" to attack enemies.
Using Assist Skill is considered as Himeko • Nova using her Skill. Himeko • Nova gains {1}% increased All-Type RES PEN and {0}% increased CRIT DMG. When attacking, can ignore Weakness Types to reduce enemy Toughness. When breaking Weakness, triggers the Fire Weakness Break effect.
When ally characters other than Himeko • Nova use their Assist Skill, regenerates 4 Energy for them.

extra.name: Hyperluminal Particle Beam
extra.desc: Deals Fire DMG equal to {0}% of Himeko • Nova's ATK to all enemies and gains 1 point(s) of "Source Energy." A maximum of 3 "Source Energy" can be held.

extra.name: Orbital Annihilation Pulse
extra.desc: Consumes 1 point of "Source Energy" to deal Fire DMG equal to {0}% of Himeko • Nova's ATK to all enemies. When the current "Source Energy" is more than 1, for every 1 point(s) of "Source Energy" consumed, additionally deals 1 instance of Fire DMG equal to {1}% of Himeko • Nova's ATK to one random enemy.

extra.name: We, Too, Stride the Stars
extra.desc: Deals {0} instance(s) of DMG, each dealing Fire DMG to one random enemy.

extra.name: Trailblaze, By Your Side
extra.desc:
Deals Fire DMG equal to {0}% of Himeko • Nova's ATK to all enemies, and additionally deals 3 instances of DMG, with each instance dealing Fire DMG equal to {1}% of Himeko • Nova's ATK to one random enemy. When used by Himeko • Nova, deals Fire DMG equal to {2}% of Himeko • Nova's ATK to all enemies, and additionally deals 4 instances of DMG, with each instance dealing Fire DMG equal to {3}% of Himeko • Nova's ATK to one random enemy.
If the user is a Trailblaze Companions character other than Himeko • Nova, then depending on the user, Himeko • Nova additionally gains 1 of the Special Effects.
The extra Assist Skill via all Special Effects can be launched up to 2 time(s) per battle, and this count is reset after Himeko • Nova uses her Ultimate.

extra.name: Companion Protocol: Verdict
extra.desc: Enters the "Companion Protocol: Verdict" state. Increases DMG dealt by Himeko • Nova by {0}%, and additionally increases her Ultimate DMG dealt by {1}%. After Himeko • Nova's teammates actively use their Ultimate 2 time(s), Himeko • Nova immediately launches 1 Assist Skill against enemies at no cost.

extra.name: Companion Protocol: Decimation
extra.desc: Enters the "Companion Protocol: Decimation" state. Increases all allies' CRIT DMG by {0}%, and additionally increases the CRIT DMG dealt by Skill by {1}%. For every 1 enemy target hit by allies, gains 1 Charge. When Charge reaches 9, consumes all Charge, and Himeko • Nova immediately launches 1 Assist Skill against enemies at no cost. This instance of Assist Skill cannot grant Charge.

technique.name: Starcharter Cruise
technique.desc:
When Himeko • Nova is in the team, increases the max Technique Points by 3.
After using Technique, enters the "Cruise" state for 30 seconds. Actively using the Technique consumes 2 Technique Points and immediately attacks all enemies within a certain range. After entering combat, immediately uses Skill 1 time at the start of each wave.
If attacking a Normal Enemy, immediately defeats them without entering combat. No Technique Points are consumed if no enemies are hit.

ability_1.name: Whither, the Last and First Men?
ability_1.desc: When Himeko • Nova launches Assist Skill, it does not consume Assist Skill uses. At the start of the turn, if the Assist Skill uses have reached the current cap, Himeko • Nova additionally regenerates 5 Energy.

ability_2.name: Hark! The Express's Pulse Roars
ability_2.desc: When a Trailblaze Companions character other than Himeko • Nova uses Assist Skill, that character immediately gains 1 extra turn in which they can insert the use of their Ultimate. The extra turn gained from Assist Skill will not repeatedly trigger this Trace effect.

ability_3.name: The Silver Rail, Hushed in Antiquity
ability_3.desc: When using Ultimate, immediately gains 3 "Source Energy." If the current "Source Energy" is 3 or more, when using the "Orbital Annihilation Pulse" attack, the DMG multiplier of "Orbital Annihilation Pulse" against random single enemies increases by 30%.

lightCones.name: A Star That Lights the Night
lightCones.description: The wearer ignores 32%/36%/40%/44%/48% of the target's DEF when dealing DMG. When the wearer uses Assist Skill, they regenerate 6 Energy and gain "Sail," lasting for 2 turns and stacking up to 3 time(s). Each stack of "Sail" increases Assist Skill DMG by 20%/25%/30%/35%/40%. When "Sail" reaches 3 stacks, each stack of "Sail" increases Ultimate DMG by 20%/25%/30%/35%/40%.

lightCones.name: Into the Unreachable Veil
lightCones.description: Increases the wearer's CRIT Rate by 12%/14%/16%/18%/20%. When the wearer uses their Ultimate, increases the wearer's Skill DMG and Ultimate DMG dealt by 60%/70%/80%/90%/100%, lasting for 3 turn(s). After the wearer uses their Ultimate, if this Ultimate consumed 140 or more Energy, recovers 1 Skill Point.

lightCones.name: Night on the Milky Way
lightCones.description: For every enemy on the field, increases the wearer's ATK by 9%/10.5%/12%/13.5%/15%, up to 5 stacks. When an enemy is inflicted with Weakness Break, the DMG dealt by the wearer increases by 30%/35%/40%/45%/50% for 1 turn.

lightCones.name: Life Should Be Cast to Flames
lightCones.description:
When the wearer's turn starts, regenerates 10 Energy. If the enemy target has a Weakness implanted by the wearer, increases the wearer's DMG dealt to it by 60%/70%/80%/90%/100%.
When an enemy target gets attacked by the wearer, the wearer decreases the target's DEF by 12%/15%/18%/21%/24%, lasting for 2 turn(s). The same types of effects cannot stack.

lightCones.name: Geniuses' Repose
lightCones.description: Increases the wearer's ATK by 16%/20%/24%/28%/32%. When the wearer defeats an enemy, the wearer's CRIT DMG increases by 24%/30%/36%/42%/48% for 3 turn(s).

lightCones.name: Today Is Another Peaceful Day
lightCones.description: After entering battle, increases the wearer's DMG based on their Max Energy. Each point of Energy increases DMG by 0.2%/0.25%/0.3%/0.35%/0.4%. A max of 160 Energy will be taken into account for this.

relicSets.name: As Navigator Isee Sees It
relicSets.description: 2-pc: Increases ATK by 12%. 4-pc: When the wearer enters combat or uses Skill, the DMG dealt by their Skill and Ultimate increases by 18%, stacking up to 3 time(s). At the start of the wearer's turn or after using Ultimate, removes 1 stack(s) of this effect.

relicSets.name: Wavestrider Captain
relicSets.description: 2-pc: Increases CRIT DMG by 16%. 4-pc: When the wearer becomes the target of another ally target's ability, gains 1 stack of "Help," stacking up to 2 time(s). If there are 2 stack(s) of "Help" when the wearer uses their Ultimate, consumes all "Help" to increase the wearer's ATK by 48% for 1 turn(s).

relicSets.name: Scholar Lost in Erudition
relicSets.description: 2-pc: Increases CRIT Rate by 8%. 4-pc: Increases DMG dealt by Skill and Ultimate by 20%. After using Ultimate, additionally increases the DMG dealt by the next Skill by 25%.

planarSets.name: Fallen Star Anchorage
planarSets.description: Increases the wearer's CRIT Rate by 8%. When entering combat, if the wearer and another teammate are both Trailblaze Companions characters, increases the wearer's CRIT DMG by 32%.

planarSets.name: The Wondrous BananAmusement Park
planarSets.description: Increases the wearer's CRIT DMG by 16%. When a target summoned by the wearer is on the field, CRIT DMG additionally increases by 32%.

planarSets.name: Rutilant Arena
planarSets.description: Increases the wearer's CRIT Rate by 8%. When the wearer's current CRIT Rate reaches 70% or higher, DMG dealt by Basic ATK and Skill increases by 20%.

teams.name: Himeko • Nova Hypercarry
teams.description: Two strong supports for Himeko • Nova. Sunday, the Remembrance Trailblazer, Cerydra, Tribbie or Mortenax Blade can replace a support, and Huohuo can replace Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae.

teams.name: Himeko • Nova with Welt
teams.description: Welt slows and weakens enemies while Mortenax Blade adds damage. Cerydra or Tribbie can replace Mortenax Blade.

teams.name: Himeko • Nova Astral Express Team
teams.description: The free Remembrance Trailblazer and Welt as supports. Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae can replace Huohuo.

lore.description:
Some fight side by side, some keep watch. The Trailblaze is never a lonely voyage.
She paints a trailblazing miracle. The silver rail stretches on, and the Nameless set sail once more, illuminating the galaxy's eternal night.
At the end of the line, she looks back once again. The dream of setting forth has never run aground.
stories: The girl's world had shrunk to just herself. The hospital's stark white sheets and curtains were like cold, impassive walls, sealing her off from the warm faces she kept in her memories. "Don't worry, Himeko. You're smart. You'll catch up even if you miss a few days!" "Himeko, you have to get better soon. We're still doing the model contest together!" "Himeko... we graduated without you..." ... Only the cold, mechanical beeping of monitors filled the room. She let her thoughts drift back to the stranded Express she had discovered, and kept sketching out those visions of setting sail. "Cosmic Station, now arriving at Cosmic Station!" A uniformed attendant rang the bell as a howling wind swept in from the distance. Though it was a little cold, she was still waving at the Express with barely contained exhilaration. "Himeko! Himeko, get on board!" A red-haired girl leaned out from the window, and a moment later, a firm hand pulled her up. In the blink of an eye, she found herself sinking into the Express's plush red velvet seat, face to face with a girl who seemed a little older, light flickering in her eyes. "Himeko, wanna take the wheel and head somewhere far away?" The familiar stranger asked with a smile. Yes! The word nearly tumbled right out of her. She wanted to talk, to have friends, to find companions, to put into words the ache in her body and the hollow longing in her heart. She wanted to run, to escape, to scream... "Come with me. Let's leave this place together." She hadn't said a word, yet somehow, the girl across from her seemed to have heard every last one of them. The girl felt a hand take hers, and her body seemed to dissolve into a night breeze, light as a feather, as though she were flying, guided by that gentle touch. Together, they brushed the wings of Cygnus and drifted through the heart of the Rosette Nebula. Icy comets streaked past the moon like a cascade of glittering gemstones. When the storm rolled in, the girl held her hand tight, weaving through the shattered debris of planetary rings, and when the skies grew calm again, the two of them watched the meteors of Sagittarius streak across the peaceful harbor... "She's so brave... just like the Navigators I've read about..." Wishes are like paint, each longing a stroke to shape the ideal into being.

She breaks into a violent coughing fit, struggling to keep her brush steady. The time she has left before she can no longer move freely is limited, and in order to get the Express to start running again, she can only allocate this remaining time to the last second. "I'm so jealous of Motoko. No need for treatments or sleep... That must free up so much time!" The girl known as Motoko gently patted her on the head. "Well that's exactly why you imagenated me, silly... I'll help you make your dream of reaching the stars come true." She burned through her own time. First was the Express, newly-restored. Its once-rusted, corroded hull had transformed into a comfortable home. With the Starblazer's blueprint recovered, crafting a prototype was now within reach. But the engine still lacked the fuel needed for Trailblazing, and the countdown timer for her life was already ticking down. They turned their eyes to Phantasmoon Games. Even if the Weathering Curse could never be healed, perhaps, in that ceremony under the gaze of the gods, the Astral Express could carry them away into the cosmos. But the bloodstained tragedy played out cycle after cycle. The Supplicant known as the Herald of Death massacred his way through Dovebrook, turning arcadia into a crimson purgatory. One by one, the innocent fell to the devil's hands, their howls and screams carried away by the wind. She slumped against the rubble as her life bled silently from her wounds. Her vision went blurry, and through the smoke and ash, she searched for that familiar silhouette. Motoko stood there, fire reflected in her eyes. And her reflection, too, was within those eyes. "Do you remember the Trailblaze pledge we read?" Barely clinging to life, she reached out toward Motoko. "Even if we don't gain the upper hand, we'll fight for right. Even when there are wheels within wheels, go ahead. Get it pulverized..." "Isn't that a little childish... I'm not even one of the Nameless yet..." She looked at Motoko the way one looks at a Navigator who lights up the long night. "Himeko, you don't have to journey far to be one of the Nameless. And similarly, Trailblazing doesn't only begin with setting sail..." Under the hopeful gazes of those around, the Wishpower of Trailblazing drew the final stroke upon the "Starblazer." The giant of Pegana descended from the sky, smashing the frenzied killer into pieces. Beneath the glow of the Phantasmoon, the Express soared into deep space. But this time, only a single soul made the departure.

The teenage girl's Trailblazing was fraught with thorns. With the silver rail blocked, she had no choice but to feel her way through the universe, remapping the astral charts. She had once been lost in desolate frontier worlds, venturing in and out of dangerous ruins just to scrape together dwindling supplies. And now, once again, she was to press on alone. She was targeted by space pirates, and in those moments of imminent peril, she did everything to shake off those desperadoes, those relics of the Energy War. She once faced a Swarm that darkened the sky. The silver rails that she painstakingly repaired over months were destroyed in an instant. She reached out to help a world on the brink of being devoured by a black hole, only to be mistaken for a malevolent visitor from beyond, and nearly lost her life at the edge of the black hole. ... "Am I really the one meant to walk this path?" At the tail end of her dreams of the Phantasmoon Games, she would often see another version of herself at the helm of the Express, soaring off into the deep reaches of space. Yet, whenever they reunited in those dreams, that graceful and poised Navigator would always look back at her with eyes full of encouragement— "Is the Rosette Nebula of the Celestial Comet System as beautiful as we always dreamed it would be? "Are the silver rails you repaired forging bonds between worlds long cut off from one another? "I know that your fearless Trailblazing saved an entire people from their destiny..." "But I... don't know how much longer I can hold on..." She sighs wearily. "Don't you remember? 'Nameless' was never just one person's name. Just as the flame of the Trailblaze set you ablaze, so will it set others ablaze too." Outside the window, the wings of Cygnus shimmered, and icy comets streaked past the moon like a cascade of glittering gemstones. She steered the Express through the shattered debris of planetary rings, and when she finally reached the peaceful harbor, the meteors of Sagittarius happened to cascade down. Welt and his golden-haired companion stepped aboard the Express. When the Express fell into peril, the taciturn Dan Heng took down the beast with a single strike. In that moment, she saw the fire inside him, and offered him the navigator's invitation. She rescued March 7th, adrift in the cosmos, and from that day on, the trailblazing expedition took on the hue of March's vibrant color. Guided by destiny, she crossed paths with Trailblazer at the space station. Somehow, the feeling that this brave, free-spirited child would bring endless surprises in the future never left her. Jarilo-VI, the Xianzhou Luofu, Penacony, Amphoreus... More and more people walk alongside the "Trailblaze," and she has found companions truly worthy of being called "family," and her name has been engraved across countless worlds. By all accounts, this was a miracle, and one that she hoped wholeheartedly would never end.

She returned to the point of departure. She knew the shadow of Destruction had never truly left, just as the bliss in Planarcadia was only a result of postponed calamity. She witnessed the return of the Herald of Death, her homeland lacerated in the maw of the beast. She uncovered the root of the curse, trembling as she accepted the truth of her family's tragedy. But this was an entirely unprecedented apocalypse. It made her face the possibility of losing her companions, Trailblazer most of all. She couldn't understand why the fate of the cosmos had to rest on his shoulders. All she knew was that he was now family, forever. So, once again, she chose to carry it all alone, just as she always used to say: "Traveling always has an end point. When it happens, I'll smile and say goodbye to everyone." Amidst the mockery of the world falling into utter silence, the Starblazer reached its limit, and the Express crashed once more. Before the farewell, she embraced Trailblazer and made a wish to the Stellaron to guard the Trailblaze. The stars grew hazy in a crimson mist, and she became as weak as she once was. "It's been so long. You've grown up... and become even more remarkable than I ever was." For a fleeting moment, she thought she could feel the girl's warmth again as if she were still there, watching over her in silence. "I think I've finally gotten a little closer to you." She couldn't help but pour out everything that had happened since they parted: The paths walked by the legendary Navigators, now trodden by her own feet; the wonders she had once only dreamed of, witnessed with her own eyes; the companions she had found, those kindred spirits, people she could truly trust... "Just as you once traded your destiny for mine, I would trade my destiny for my companions'..." "But look, your companions aren't about to let you go anywhere." Trailblazer's wish moved her to tears. The unyielding defiance of the Nameless set her blood ablaze once more. "Where your journey ends, mine begins anew..." Two warm hands withdrew gently from her back, and the girl smiled with quiet tenderness, their silhouette slowly merging with each other. "If there's nothing ahead of us..." She became one with the ideal she had always strived toward, as her companions reached out their hands and cried out together, "Then we'll Trailblaze a path forward with our own hands!"
